name: Sonogi Akihiro
source:
A young, second-term member of the House of Representatives. Favored by Taichiro Hareyama, Minister of Justice and head of the Seiran faction.
Attended an all-boys integrated junior and senior high school in Kyoto, then went on to Kyoto Imperial University’s Faculty of Law. After one year working at a bank, he soon ran for the House of Representatives.
With both a striking appearance and a prestigious background—not to mention strong leadership skills—he has become a popular politician despite his youth. Having grown up watching his parents’ cold, loveless marriage, he has little hope or interest in marrying himself.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
